Senses.Explanation: An imperative: do not (莫) understand or take it (會) wrongly (錯). Its distinct Chan deployment is as a master's warning attached directly to a saying or answer in public discourse. Asked the intention of the coming from the West, one master answers 'it is so, but do not get it wrong.' An extended address says not to infer 'not round and not sudden' from the preceding words and not to present borrowed, similar, or calculated phrases as one's own understanding, repeating 'do not get it wrong.' Elsewhere a master warns an assembly not to say that speech, silence, movement, and stillness are all buddha-affairs. The formula can also follow an unexplained seasonal statement — 'yesterday snow, today it melts' — leaving the warning itself as the only explicit appraisal. These contexts establish the public-interview function without supplying an interpretation of what the preceding words secretly mean.
Senses.Note: Allowlist count: 168 hits in 73 texts. Variants include emphatic take care not to get it wrong (莫錯會好) and just do not get it wrong (且莫錯會). One imperative sense; preceding statements do not create different referents.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問。如何是西來意。師曰。是即是。莫錯會。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), Anguo Hongtao section. Anguo Hongtao is the exact respondent who answers a monk's question about the meaning of coming from the West with, 'It is so, but do not understand it wrongly.'

Occurrences.Kwic: 莫錯會好莫見與麼道便向不圓不頓處卜度者裏也須是箇人始得莫將依師語相似語測度語到處呈中將為自己見解莫錯會
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), in Zhaozhou Congshen's record. Zhaozhou Congshen is the exact speaker warning the assembly, 莫錯會.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸人還委悉麼？莫道語默動靜無非佛事好，且莫錯會。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷). Record of the Transmission of the Lamp in the Jingde Era (景德傳燈錄), Bao'en Huiming section. Bao'en Huiming is the exact hall speaker who warns the assembly not to say that speech, silence, movement, and stillness are all buddha-activity and tells them not to understand wrongly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 昨日雪，今日消。仔細高著眼，莫錯會好！
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷). Complete Book of the Five Lamps (五燈全書), Songru Daomi section. Songru Daomi is the exact hall speaker who tells the assembly to look carefully and not understand yesterday's snow and today's thaw wrongly.
